root_cause.summary: In workflow branch-ci.yml, job 'Smoke acceptance' step 'Provision real worker sandbox' executes 'sudo apt-get update'. GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest runners include /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google-chrome.list pointing to https://dl.google.com/linux/chrome-stable/deb. At 2026-09-09T17:27:58Z, Google published a new Release file declaring main/binary-amd64/Packages.gz with MD5 2fc39e32c7bdf718a907c390338392ea and SHA256 233e56de019b57db89238fa7bcc3647718dbbea3a40c2dc1c633a8c8952aa9e9, but Google's CDN edge continued serving the previous Packages.gz (last modified 09:41:12 GMT) with MD5 2ce0a26fc7a49a488341fc13c6d05b52 and SHA256 bc1428ab27c6d76ee9bb76de07f1ded0ddb4aaabd958fc72855634ef5894a4b3. The resulting Hash Sum mismatch caused apt-get update to exit with code 100 before test execution began.

reproduction_evidence.ci_error_message: E: Failed to fetch https://dl.google.com/linux/chrome-stable/deb/dists/stable/main/binary-amd64/Packages.gz Hash Sum mismatch

google_cdn_probe.proof_of_cdn_desync: Uncompressed Packages file on dl.google.com matches Release file hashes when gzipped locally, confirming origin server uploaded new Packages but CDN edge serves stale Packages.gz.
